documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Complete Financials Results For Year Ended 31 March, 2026.

analysis.summary: Sparkle Gold Rock Limited (formerly Sree Jayalakshmi Autospin Limited) presented its 34th Annual Report for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, detailing operational results, name and object changes, and related party transactions. The company reported revenue from operations of 900.03 lakhs and a net loss after tax of 24.50 lakhs for FY2025. Management highlighted changes in the company's business objects to include precious metals, mining, textiles, and construction, alongside a name change to Sparkle Gold Rock Limited. Additionally, the company entered into related party transactions for purchasing bullion and precious metals and appointed M/s G.R. Gupta and Company as statutory auditors.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand conditions in the real estate sector are showing early signs of improvement.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company believes that demand conditions in the real estate sector are exhibiting early signs of improvement, and signs of declining interest rates as well as renewed activity in the lending and public capital markets are expected to ease funding pressures.

capital_allocation.quote: Reserves: The Company has not transferred any amount to reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not accept or renew any deposits during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: Deposits: The Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits during the year under review.
